changes: Knobs on SRC parameters now use the track's machine's own names, values and ranges, also for module machines such as Digi Mono, SOPHIE, NEIGHBOR and RAM.
The header shows the track, the parameter's full name and its value with its unit.
A knob on an SRC slot the machine doesn't have is unassigned.
Fixed a delay between turning a knob and the sound changing with Overbridge connected and a heavy machine playing; the page now uses about as much CPU as a stock page.
Fixed the Perform page staying on screen when the Digitakt's screen saver turns the display off. The screen now goes fully dark, and a key press wakes it.
On OS 1.53 the unit may show the normal TRIG page after waking instead of the Perform page; tap TRIG again to come back.
Fixed the second Filter page: FLT.BASE now moves the filter base, FLT.WDTH the width and FLT.DEL the envelope delay. They were shifted by one place.
Saved assignments keep playing as before; one that played as width and was named BASE now shows as WDTH.
First release: a Perform page, the second page of TRIG (tap TRIG again), with eight macro knobs A-H.
Each knob moves one track parameter, or the same parameter of every track, with the stock knob feel and FUNC-and-turn snaps.
Assign on the page (FUNC and a knob's push) or in SETTINGS > PERFORM EDIT. Assignments are saved per pattern with the project.
Hold TRIG and press REC, STOP or PLAY to copy, paste or clear the page. The offsets let go when a new pattern starts.
Not compatible with Digi Matrix. For OS 1.53 and 1.54; experimental, hardware-tested by its author only.
